       KEVIN KENNEDY’S SUPPLEMENTAL CERTIFICATE OF CONFERENCE
                 REGARDING THE VERIFIED MOTION FOR RECUSAL
                      OF CHAIRMAN THOMAS J. GLEESON

      I certify that on November 20, 2026, I made reasonable attempts to confer with parties that
could be affected by the motion. I sent an email asking the recipients to state their positions on
my verified motion for recusal, filed as Item 645 in Docket No. 59182 and Item 6677 in Docket
No. 59475. I requested a reply by 2:00 p.m. time that day.

      I sent the email to Jaren Taylor and Nicole E. Burleson of Vinson & Elkins for Oncor, Kirk
Rasmussen and Catherine E. Garza of Jackson Walker for LCRA TSC, Scott Miles and Dylan
King for Commission Staff, Connor Drysdale and the service address for the Office of Public
Utility Counsel (OPUC), and John B. Bradley III.

      Connor Drysdale, Assistant Public Counsel, replied on behalf of OPUC that, “OPUC takes
no position on the motion.” As of the time I signed this certificate, I had received no other
response.

Respectfully submitted,
Kevin Kennedy
By: /s/ J. Kevin Kennedy
Pro se Intervenor
630 County Road 282
Bertram, TX 78605
(512) 639-1720
jkkennedy.tx@gmail.com




                                 CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE
      I certify that on November 20, 2026, a copy of this document was filed on the PUC
Interchange and thereby served on all parties of record in Docket Nos. 59182 and 59475 in
accordance with 16 TAC § 22.74, SOAH Order No. 2 in Docket No. 59182, and SOAH Order
No. 1 in Docket No. 59475.

By: /s/ J. Kevin Kennedy
Kevin Kennedy
